reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Don't label RBAC roles with the XRD that created them by @negz in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6521", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: RBAC roles created by XRDs no longer carry labels that identify which XRD created them; any scripts or tools that rely on these labels to identify role origins will need to be updated.

proposed.statement: RBAC roles created by XRDs no longer receive labels identifying which XRD created them.
